## Context
Gerrit change 2851 patch set 1 reached CI run 34280297343. The py3.13 gating job failed only at `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py::test_sweep_extra_parity_would_have_caught_c57057f41`. The test invokes `git show c57057f41:.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml`, while the Gerrit checkout action uses `fetch-depth: 1`, so that historical object is absent. CI reported 1 failed, 20,171 passed, and 82 skipped. This is independent of the comment-only patch. A separate debug session should establish and fix the root cause.

## Reproduction
Run the gating suite from a Gerrit patch-set checkout created with `fetch-depth: 1`. Observe `git show` exit 128 for `c57057f41` in the named parity test.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The parity regression remains meaningful without assuming an unavailable historical commit in a shallow Gerrit checkout.
- [ ] The gating py3.13 job can execute the test from the documented Gerrit checkout topology.
- [ ] Focused regression evidence covers the shallow-history case.
- [ ] The Gerrit change that fixes the issue receives `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`.
